learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparing numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected The kettle for 2000 W three minutes versus 60 W two hours and locked it in. Initial bulb slider was one hour.
observations.exploration: Set bulb to two hours: bulb 0.12 kWh versus kettle three minutes 0.10, reveal unlocked. Set kettle to six minutes: kettle 0.20 versus bulb 0.12, reversing ordering while reveal stayed unlocked.
observations.reveal: Corrected original question to bulb, explicitly cites question's two-hour/three-minute case despite current six-minute state. Explains power times time, thick/thin energy slices, steady label-power assumption and kWh-to-joule conversion.
observations.visual: Inline screenshot inspected at six-minute kettle: orange bar 0.20 taller than green 0.12; slice lines caption kettle one minute, bulb ten minutes. Controls and units legible. Trust count4/4 ignored.
observations.isolation: No-history evaluation preview banner present. Visible trust count ignored.
observations.reference: Own CUA tab 543884122 snapshots and inspected inline screenshot; no screenshot file saved.
